WildSpark 2.2.10 restores rare-spawn reference respawn information in WildInfo tooltips. It includes fixed and ranged estimates plus event-triggered notes for 75 NPC records. These reference values are clearly marked as unverified for WoW Forever; local and peer-shared observations remain primary.

This release also restores required gathering profession levels on custom minimap marker hover tooltips, color-codes the requirement by current skill, and adds a green check to WildGroups listings after asking to join.
